Source: uploaded Rat_Sightings.xlsx · 114,507 records · January 1, 2010 – June 25, 2018
All data, charts, map tiles and application code are embedded in this file. No network connection or setup is required.
Data definitions & quality notes

Each spreadsheet row counts as one sighting record. Closed percentage = records whose Status is “Closed” ÷ all filtered records. Resolution time = Closed Date − Created Date for closed cases with valid, nonnegative durations; it is an average of elapsed calendar days, not business days. Dates stored as text are parsed day/month/year. ZIP circles use the mean coordinates of the filtered records with a valid five-digit ZIP; these are report centroids, not official postal centroids or boundaries. Samples are deterministic and are not used to calculate any metric. The forecast is an ordinary least squares projection of complete monthly counts; it is descriptive and does not model seasonality or imply causation. The source ends during June 2018; subsequent months are missing, not zero. Esri tiles are embedded at zoom 11 and are scaled when zooming for offline use.
